descriptive_durations.scope: One recorded-action request per development scene after three separate warmups. Includes policy instrumentation; observational durations are not matched benchmark latency, tail-latency or speedup acceptance.

reasons: Numerical validation uses a different GPU or runtime
Numerical validation must use the development manifest
A different benchmark manifest must be explicitly held out
Benchmark evaluation scenes overlap or lack verified provenance
legacy_numerical_gate.scope: selected development request numerical checks only

limits: Fresh 32-scene development companion under separately declared A100 math-SDPA runtime; distinct from four-scene smoke and historical H100 development runs.
The unchanged strict pass covers one selected request, not all 32 scenes.
Successful generation is not quality validation, optimization selection, calibrated tolerance, action adherence or safety evidence.
Frozen d8 implementation, original 18-variant H100 plan and previous publication snapshots remain unchanged.

Complete generation and diagnostic archives are independently hash-verified locally. Hash verification and saved-metric provenance are not a local recomputation of metrics from raw frames or a quality-acceptance test.

Recorded-future RGB/temporal diagnostics do not provide LPIPS, review, tolerance calibration, action adherence, safety or quality acceptance. Temporal/freeze proxies are frame-indexed rather than normalized to physical time.

recorded_future_diagnostics.aggregate_scope: Equal per-scene means and source-recorded scene-bootstrap intervals over the fixed 32-scene development cohort; descriptive only, not population or equivalence acceptance.

freeze_proxy.interpretation: Frame-indexed thresholded global mean pixel-change proxy; not literal freeze, physical-time motion, action adherence or safety.
